visibleTestCases.title: Supervisor Reports Active Worker
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, Sup, W1} = exit_trapper:start_supervised(fun() -> receive stop -> ok end end), {ok, Reported} = exit_trapper:get_worker_pid(Sup), Sup ! stop, W1 =:= Reported end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Supervisor correctly initialized and returned worker pid.

visibleTestCases.title: Automatic Respawn on Abnormal Crash
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, Sup, W1} = exit_trapper:start_supervised(fun() -> receive stop -> ok end end), exit_trapper:kill_worker(Sup, badarith), timer:sleep(50), {ok, W2} = exit_trapper:get_worker_pid(Sup), Sup ! stop, {is_process_alive(W1), is_process_alive(W2), W1 =/= W2} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: When W1 died, supervisor trapped exit and spawned fresh worker W2.

visibleTestCases.title: Untrappable Kill Signal Simulation
visibleTestCases.explanation: Even with trap_exit=true, kill terminates process and reports killed.
